message: FORGE-TERSE-1.1 requires exactly five forge-next steps but names four append concepts; its accepted-but-uncommitted decision trigger also conflicts with the task-grill resolution that rules that trigger out. Clarify the fifth step and binding decision-hygiene predicate.

notes: Binding: FIVE moved messages, FOUR steps - the mapping governs, not the loose '5 steps' phrase: (1) pr_ready commit-archive -> commit-the-evidence step [post-ship branch]; (2) record_signoff commit-pin -> commit-the-pin step [signed-off branch]; (3)+(4) decisions.py supersedes/confirmed_by reminder AND trailer command -> ONE decision-hygiene step; (5) roadmap spec-debt lecture -> spec-debt step [post-sign-off]. Decision-hygiene predicate, binding per the task-grill resolution (it postdates and refines the plan): pure file reads only - fire when (a) a supersedes flip is pending (both records active) OR (b) a decision is status accepted with empty confirmed_by; when either fires the step text carries the full hygiene guidance including the git commit --trailer command. No git-dirtiness check. Implement now; the contract is complete.
